بَاكُورَةٌ [as a subst.]: see بِكْرٌ. ―
-b2- Also, (S, K,) or بَاكُورَةٌ الفَا كِهَةِ, (A, Msb,) (tropical:) The first of fruit: (S:) or the first that comes to maturity, of fruit: (A, Msb, K:) or fruit that hastens to come forth: (AHát, Msb:) pl. بَوَاكِيرُ and بَاكُورَاتٌ. (Msb.) ―
-b3- The pl. بَوَاكِيرُ also signifies (assumed tropical:) Winds that announce [coming] rain. (A in art. بشر)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
